name: HydrantValveExerciseTracker
tagline: Run the whole hydrant flushing and valve exercising programme in one Power Platform control.
description: Cycle compliance for every hydrant and valve, a crew schedule with capacity and auto-planning, field results with turbidity, chlorine, pressure and valve-turn rules, a defects board with fire-service notices, zone compliance and a public hydrant status lookup – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Hydrant, valve and critical-valve cycles with per-asset override
Compliance per asset, zone and programme
Crew schedule with capacity, drag-and-drop and Auto-plan
Valve turns tolerance and position rules
Flushing turbidity, chlorine and pressure rules with water volume
Bulk actions, CSV export, job sheets, undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: HydrantValveExerciseTracker data-set + HydrantValveExerciseTrackerPortal field control)
